# The Latest News from the Center for Wooden Boats

## Subscribe

---

# September 2026 Newsletter

*Dated August 30, from Executive Director Josh Anderson*

**Highlights** — The 50th Anniversary Reunion drew over 350 people, and summer camps set a record.

**Events and Updates**
- **Happy Hour 4 Good** — September 17, 6:00–8:00 PM, hosted by the Lake Union Rotary Club to support Youth Programs. [RSVP Today!](https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/happy-hour-for-good-benefitting-the-center-for-wooden-boats)
- **[Norm Blanchard W.O.O.D. Regatta](https://www.cwb.org/wood-regatta)** — Saturday, September 19. Racers 12 and up; BBQ tickets sold separately.
- **[Sunday Public Sail](https://www.cwb.org/public-sail)** — September 27, 1:00–5:00 PM, last of the season. Sign-ups start at 1:00 PM in front of the Wagner Education Center; first come, first served.
- **TWSBA Conference** — October 15–17, hosted by CWB. [Learn More and Register](https://teachingwithsmallboats.org/conferences/)

**Fleet Constructions, Restorations, and Repairs** — MS Wolf was towed to the NLU shop. Buttermint will receive new paint, seats, floorboards, inwales, and a tiller.

**Fall Youth Sailing** — Learn to Race, September–October. [Learn More About Fall Youth Sailing](https://www.cwb.org/youth-school-year-sailing)

**Adult Programs** — [SailNOW!](https://www.cwb.org/sailnow-learn-to-sail), [Basic Keel Boat](https://www.cwb.org/us-sailing-basic-keelboat-certification) (monthly), 16-hour [Safe Powerboat Handling](https://www.cwb.org/safe-powerboat-handling), [Small Boat Navigation](https://www.cwb.org/small-boat-navigation) (October 3–4). [Learn More About Our Adult Sailing Programs](https://www.cwb.org/adult-sailing)

**Fuel the Mission** — Minimum goal of $850,000, stretch goal of $1 million. [Click to Make a Donation](https://www.cwb.org/give)

# August 2026 Newsletter

*Dated August 2*

**Highlights**

**50th Anniversary Reunion** — August 22, 5:00–8:00 PM. Thanks to event sponsors including Olson Kundig. [RSVP Today!](https://www.cwb.org/50th)

- **[Sunday Public Sail](https://www.cwb.org/public-sail)** — August 30, 1:00–5:00 PM.
- **W.O.O.D. Regatta** — sign-ups open mid-August.

**Fleet Constructions, Restorations, and Repairs** — Safety boat Larry returned to the water; the Kolin Skiff Gloria is being repaired; Buttermint is returning to Livery.

**Youth Summer Camps** — June–August, some spots still open. [Learn More](https://www.cwb.org/summer-camps)

**Adult Programs** — SailNOW!, Basic Keelboat, [Performance Sailing](https://www.cwb.org/performance-sailing), and the [Summer Racing Series](https://www.cwb.org/summer-racing-series) (Thursdays, July 9–September 3).

**Fuel the Mission** — [Click to Make a Donation](https://www.cwb.org/give)

# July 2026 Newsletter

*Dated July 5, from Development Director Corey McDaniel*

**Highlights**

**[Dinner on the Docks with Sugartime Trio](https://www.cwb.org/dinneronthedocksw/sugartime)** — Thursday, July 23, 6:00–9:00 PM. 21+; Mediterranean buffet by [Ravishing Radish Catering](https://ravishingradish.com/), drinks included; tiered ticket pricing.

**Sunset Yoga on the Docks** — Tuesday, July 14, 6:30–8:00 PM. Complimentary, with DRIFT Yoga. Members reserve by emailing [flowwithus@driftyogajuicebar.com](mailto:flowwithus@driftyogajuicebar.com). Bring your own mat.

**[Sunday Public Sail](https://www.cwb.org/public-sail)** — July 26, 1:00–5:00 PM. The Virginia 5 returns to the fleet.

**TWSBA Conference**

**50th Anniversary Reunion**

Hours: Wednesday – Sunday, 12:30–8:00 PM.

**Fleet Constructions, Restorations, and Repairs** — The red El Toro "Mario" is finished, with the green "Luigi" to follow, for youth programs. Free Boating Day (June 14): 71 volunteers helped get nearly 500 people on the water.

**Youth Summer Camps** · **2026 Summer Racing Series** · **Safe Powerboat Handling** · **Performance Sailing**

**Become a Volunteer** — [Learn More about Volunteering](https://www.cwb.org/volunteer)

**Host Your Event on the Water** — Fleet Keeper members receive 10% off facility rentals. [Click to Learn More About Facility Rental](https://www.cwb.org/facility-rentals)

**Boats for Sale** — 2020 Elf Gaff Sloop "Solace"; reduced prices on several boats. [Click to View More Boats for Sale](https://www.cwb.org/boats-for-sale-1)

# June 2026 Newsletter

*Dated June 1*

**Highlights**

- **International Soccer Celebration Public Sail** — Sunday, June 14, 1:00–5:00 PM, followed by [Beers in the Boathouse](https://www.cwb.org/beersintheboathousejune2026), 5:00–8:00 PM (21+, reservations required, dinner by Ravishing Radish Catering). [RSVP](https://donorbox.org/events/936523/steps/choose_tickets)
- **Sunset Yoga** — June 9, 6:30–8:00 PM, members only. Questions: membership@cwb.org
- **[Tiny Boat Regatta](https://www.cwb.org/tiny-boat-regatta)** — June 6, wooden sailboats 14 feet and under; BBQ tickets sold separately.

**[Jubilee Art Exhibition](https://www.cwb.org/prima-jubilee)** — PRIMA, open through November 8 in the Wagner Education Center; 17 artists, 38 pieces.

**TWSBA Conference** · **50th Anniversary Reunion Event**

**[Best in The PNW](https://www.votethepnw.com)** — Voting June 8–26.

**General Restoration Update** — Larry returned to the water; Riff the Cat Boat repaired at NLU.

**New Digital Livery Passes** — Livery pass prices reduced for the shorter season. [Get a Livery Pass or Renew](https://www.cwb.org/boat-rentals)

**Youth Summer Camps** — begin June 22. · **2026 Summer Racing Series** · **Safe Powerboat Handling** · **Performance Sailing** · **Fuel the Mission** · **Become a Volunteer** · **Host Your Event on the Water** · **Boats for Sale**

# May 2026 Newsletter

*Dated May 1, from Josh Anderson and Corey McDaniel*

**Highlights**

**[GiveBIG](https://www.wagives.org/organization/Center-For-Wooden-Boats)** — May 5; early giving began April 28. About 90,000–100,000 people visited campus last year.

**Mother's Day Public Sail** — May 10, 1:00–5:00 PM.

**Jubilee Art Exhibition** — PRIMA, opened May 6, through November 8; 17 artists, 37 pieces.

**50th Anniversary Reunion Event** · **First Public Sail of the Year**

**General Restoration Update** — Boatwright Apprentice Alex is refreshing the El Toros; Dora is having her keel replaced at the NLU shop, targeted to return in summer.

**New Digital Membership Cards** — [Become a Member or Renew Today](https://www.cwb.org/membership)

**Youth Summer Camps & Racing Teams** — Summer camps (June–August), Youth Sailing team, and a new Youth Dragon Boat team. [Race Teams](https://www.cwb.org/race-team-2025)

**US Sailing Basic Keelboat Certification** — first Saturday monthly. [Register](https://www.cwb.org/us-sailing-basic-keelboat-certification)

**Safe Powerboat Handling** · **Performance Sailing** (third weekend monthly) · **Become a Volunteer** · **Host Your Event on the Water**

**Boats for Sale** — William Garden–designed Tom Cat, reduced price.
